title: Romblon governor seeks wider social pension coverage for seniors

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Romblon Gov. Trina Firmalo-Fabic on Friday urged the national government to expand the social pension program’s coverage to include senior citizens receiving low monthly pensions from the Social Security System (SSS) and Government Service Insurance System (GSIS). Firmalo-Fabic made the call during the province’s observance of Elderly Filipino Week 2026 in Looc
